findings.claim: When data[gasParameter] is null, Number(null) evaluates to 0, which passes the Number.isFinite() check, so the code silently treats a missing oracle parameter as a valid zero value instead of raising an error.
The Etherscan response parsing has the same issue as the non-Etherscan path: a null parameter value converts to 0 via Number(null) and passes validation instead of being flagged as missing.
